title: Chatwoot Cloud to self-hosted Chatwoot
summary: Same software either way, so this is the cleanest comparison on the site: purely the price of someone else running it.

you_lose: Managed upgrades on a Rails app with Postgres, Redis and Sidekiq behind it
Deliverability handled for you — running your own inbound and outbound mail is its own project
Support from the people who wrote it
you_gain: Identical software with no per-agent charge
Customer conversations on infrastructure you control, which is often the actual requirement
No ceiling on agents, inboxes or conversation volume

caveats: Chatwoot self-hosted is the same product, so there is no feature trade-off to weigh — only operational cost. That makes the hourly rate below unusually decisive.
Email deliverability is the hidden cost. If your support inbox runs on email, budget for a transactional mail provider on top of the figures here.
The stack wants 4 GB. It will boot in 2 GB and then fall over during a busy hour.
